edges.description: Madurella Cyp51-mediated lanosterol demethylation permits the remaining sterol reactions that yield ergosterol.
Ergosterol produced by Madurella is incorporated into the fungal plasma membrane, where it supports membrane organization.
intermediate_mechanisms: ergosterol insertion into the Madurella plasma membrane
sterol-dependent membrane packing and membrane-protein organization

nodes.description: Itraconazole is a standard antifungal treatment for eumycetoma and served as the daily control arm in the Phase II fosravuconazole trial.

evidence.reference_title: Eumycetoma and actinomycetoma--an update on causative agents, epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnostics and therapy.
evidence.snippet: This triazole antifungal is considered as 'gold standard' for eumycetomas.

evidence.reference_title: A Randomized, Double Blind Phase II Proof-of-Concept Superiority Trial of Fosravuconazole 200 mg or 300 mg Weekly Dose Versus Itraconazole 400 mg Daily, All Three Arms in Combination With Surgery, in Patients With Eumycetoma in Sudan
evidence.snippet: the control arm is the standard treatment using itraconazole 400mg daily.

nodes.description: Completion of sterol biosynthesis produces ergosterol for the Madurella plasma membrane. This node is the normal molecular output downstream of the azole target in the Eumycetoma branch.

evidence.reference_title: Terbinafine: mode of action and properties of the squalene epoxidase inhibition.
evidence.snippet: Treated fungi accumulate squalene while becoming deficient in ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes.

nodes.description: Ergosterol incorporation supports organization and integrity of the Madurella plasma membrane. This node records the normal cellular output of ergosterol biosynthesis rather than a drug-induced depletion state.

evidence.reference_title: Terbinafine: mode of action and properties of the squalene epoxidase inhibition.
evidence.snippet: Treated fungi accumulate squalene while becoming deficient in ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes.

nodes.description: Madurella uses fungal sterol 14-alpha-demethylase in its ergosterol pathway. The CYP51/ERG11 enzyme activity is the Eumycetoma-local therapeutic vulnerability inhibited by itraconazole. This node represents normal enzyme activity; inhibition is encoded on the treatment edge.

evidence.reference_title: Sterol 14α-Demethylase Ligand-Binding Pocket-Mediated Acquired and Intrinsic Azole Resistance in Fungal Pathogens.
evidence.snippet: The fungal cytochrome P450 enzyme sterol 14α-demethylase (SDM) is a key enzyme in the ergosterol biosynthesis pathway.
